name: nws-nbm-viewer
description: Real-time map viewer for the NOAA/NWS National Blend of Models (NBM v4.2+) — deterministic, percentile and exceedance elements.

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else python3 -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi'
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q; else python3 -m pytest -q; fi'
scripts.setup:backend: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/flake8 ]; then .venv/bin/flake8 .; else flake8 .; fi'
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/black ]; then .venv/bin/black .; else black .; fi'
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:backend
